book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Yesu vet moux 5,000
Ka bouk valu lak veil en inyon, eno Yesu la lounyeing Galili loxalu nei, inyei lounyeing lei nge eno Taiberias.
De xomaxoneing ngenongakes betiy e me la, en nambei xel yei dee wei lulvako wei wong xel wei vanei eno wo nimzalek o.
Woyom Yesu lek lukendu me la toundei is e xe xel betiyeing.
De Yudayeiw xe bouk ngandoung wei Pasova eno lam paviy.
Gyeik ingwei Yesu veilma lek me yei xomaxoneing ngenong di lam wou e, eno neil wou Pilip bei, “Tyek xey a bou belet anghei inya me na bong wou xel beimambei ne en xel gya?”
Moxo teling tine en embei daxe Pilip, en moxo wounalei en vati wei embei bong o woy.
Pilip lewexe wou e bei, “Wangwei xey a bou belet lek malew vaxak yuw on tyek se teyei xel ne titi bei xel gya nayak kaka!”
Moxo xe betiyeing nge inyon Andrias wei Simon Petele li eno luk bei,
“Yak ti toundei inye eno di qou bali belet nayak lim de woing nayak yayuw, ekom tyek inye devind xomaxoneing ngenong ne nambei nya?”
Yesu neil embei, “Xam neil wou xomaxoneing on en xel mendei tembuing o.” Qeis ngenong toundei inyon, om xel dei lek. De moux wei dei yon teyei lek ambei 5,000.
Woyom Yesu qou belet me wong dange wou Anutu de wong wou xomaxoneing dalus wei toundei inyon eno xel ya me enden xel. Moxo wong ambei nyon wou woing is.
Ka xel dalusateiv ya woy, moxo neil wou e xe xel betiyeing bei, “Xam qekuwou myapapu wei toundei yo en kandek ti se nati.”
Om xel qekuwou myapapu wei belet lim wei xel ya de toundei yo me sei eivek pasik xoumeeng yuw me epup.
Ka xomaxoneing yei dee wei lulvako wei Yesu wong o, eno xel neil embei, “Neing ayang inye Poropet tiwei Anutu neil embei bong e nam lek tembuing o.”
Yesu woulek bei xel embei nam tendu e me embo king wei xel o, om moxo venaxow la veil xel me lox me la lukendu no.
Yesu la lek memiing mapu
Sayeiv la eivek, eno e xe xel betiyeing lep me la xo wei lounyeing nei,
de xel la eivek bot ti me sepa lounyeing me la Kapenaom. Inye bouk, de Yesu se ghei la wou xel.
Laweeng nikanzek ti vei om lounyeing vuklek.
Xel di sepa me la teyei lek kilomita lim o limti, de xel yei Yesu di la lek lounyeing mapu me la paviy xel om xel yaleeng ngandoung.
Ekom moxo neil wou xel bei, “Inye ay yo, om xam seng gwaleeng.”
Woyom xel toung laleind lekti bei qou e me na eivek bot, de lutika eno bot la nenyawes lek beyeeng tiwei xel embei na yo.
Bouk nge eno moux alis vex nanghei toundei lounyeing nenyawes nge loxalu nei en xel yeimend wou bei bot tixemou di yeip inyei, de Yesu se la is e xe xel betiyeing, qe xel venaxow la.
Woyom xel Taiberias xe bot valu lam paviy beyeeng wei Tambiy Ngandoung wong dange en belet me xel ya yo.
De xel qendu yon yeimend wou bei Yesu lis e xe xel betiyeing se toundei. Om xel la eivek bot ti beimambei yon me la Kapenaom en xel embei na gyimexe Yesu.
Yesu e belet wei mapieing o
Gyeik ingwei xel yeiwou e nanghei lounyeing loxalu nei, eno xel teling e, “Putoung, wang lam inye gyeik inya?”
Yesu lewexe, “A neil wou xam zonghek, xam seng wimexe ay en ingwei xam ghe wei dee wei lulvako yo, qe en ingwei xam ghe wa belet me e den xam o.

Xam seng bong xuk en lul yaeing wei mi wo nol o, qe en lul yaeing wei emi mendei mapieing luta luta yo, wei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek bong wou xam o. En moxo eno Ma Anutu beyal bei e bong lei ngandoung me bong ambei nyon.”
Woyom xel teling wou moxo, “Xa bong vati me na bong Anutu xe xuk?”
Yesu lewexe bei, “Anutu xe xuk eno nambei nye: Xam ghe bongis tambiy tiwei Anutu wong e lam o.”
Om xel teling wou e, “Tyek wang bong dee wei lulvako vati yo en xa ghei me na bongis wang? Tyek wang bo vati?
Xa bumiyeiw ya mana eivek tembuing bandaing, nambei xel byex eivek xoulek bei,

content.text: ‘Moxo wong belet wei tyoung gheyapu yo me xel ya.’” Qouloum 16:4

content: Yesu neil wou xel, “A neil wou xam zonghek, inye Mose se wong belet wei tyoung gheyapu eno wou xam, qe Mang wong belet zonghek wei tyoung gheyapu eno wou xam.
En belet wei Anutu xe eno inye e tiwei lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu nei me wong mapieing wou xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa yo.”
Xel neil embei, “Teiv, wa mi bong belet tiyon wou xa taxombouk.”
Woyom Yesu neilteyei bei, “A maxow belet wei mapieing o. Xelti embei nam wou ay eno tyek se na maxep, me xelti embei bongis ay eno tyek kwa se tip en memiing.
Ekom nambei a neil wou xam o, xam ghe wei ay ekom xam se ghei wongis.
Xel dalus wei Mang wong wou ay eno tyek nam wou ay, de xelti embei nam wou ay eno tyek a se saing xel.
En a lep me lam anghei tyoung gheyapu nei en ambei se betiwou a maxow xe woueing nalei, qe woueing nalei wei tambiy tiwei wong a lam o.
De lalei vineing wei tambiy tiwei wong a lam eno nambei nye, tyek a se saing xel wei wong wou ay eno ti, qe tyek a piyexe xel lek bouk loxyus.
En Mang xe woueing nalei nambei nye xel eti yeiw wei yei Neu Moux me wongis e eno tyek na qou deing mapieing luta luta, de tyek a piyexe e lek bouk loxyus.”
Woyom Yudayeiw ngo inyon eno xel luk niseik seik en nambei moxo neil embei, “A belet wei lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu yo.”
Xel neil embei, “Beip inye se Yesu Yosep neu wei xey a woulek ma luw ta yo? Nambei nya gweimbeeng neil embei, ‘A lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu’?”
Ekom Yesu neil elox bei, “Xam tip lukeing ngenong on eivek xam venaxow senghoing.
Xelti tyek se nam wou ay qe ka Mang tiwei wong a lam eno na puw e nam le, de tyek a piyexe e qandi lek bouk loxyus.
Qayeeng yeip eivek xoulek wei xel poropet byex o bei,
Xel eti yeiw wei mi ngo Mang me qou kwa wou e eno tyek nam wou ay.
Xelti se yei Mang. Qe e tiwei toundei is Anutu me lam eno emaxow yei Ma.
A neil wou xam zonghek, e tiwei mi wongis eno qou mapieing luta luta.
A maxow belet wei mapieing o.
Xam bumimyeiw ya mana eivek tembuing bandaing, ekom xel mey.
Ekom inye belet wei lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu, bei xomaxoneing gya dom xel se mey.

A maxow belet wei mapieing wei lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu yo. Wangwei xelti embei gya belet tine, on tyek mendei mapieing luta luta. Belet tine inye a leyeis, wei tyek a bong bei embong mapieing wou xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa yo.”
Woyom Yudayeiw di pyalek ama eivek xel venaxow senghoing me neil, “Nambei nya tambiy tine tyek bong emaxow leyeis me xey a gha?”
Yesu neil wou xel, “A neil wou xam zonghek, wangwei xam ambei seng gwa Xomaxoneing Neu Moux leyeis me na num e gyand ond xam seng qou mapieing eivek xow.
Xelti embei gya a leyeis me na num a gyand on tyek na qou mapieing luta luta, de tyek a piyexe e lek bouk loxyus.
En a leyeis on yaeing zonghek me a gyand on numeing zonghek.
Xelti embei gya a leyeis me na num a gyand yond mindei eivek ay de a mindei eivek e.
Nambei ingwei Mang wei mapieing eno wong a lam me a toundei mapieing en Mang, om xelti embei gya a leyeis on tyek mendei mapieing en ay.
Tine inye belet wei lam axone nanghei tyoung gheyapu nei yo. Xam bumimyeiw ya mana de mey, ekom xelti embei gya belet tine ond tyek mendei mapieing luta luta.”
Yesu neil lul tine gyeik ingwei di teyoxe xel eivek xomek qekueing ama nanghei Kapenaom o.
Xel betiyeing ngenong la veil Yesu
Xel ngo inyon de e xe xel betiyeing ngenong neil, “Teyoxeing on wo nimaying. Eti tyek na zeimaxoun inyon?”
Yesu woulek bei e xe xel betiyeing di luk ngenong en tine, om Yesu neil wou xel, “Qayeeng tine wo nol wou xam laleimim?
Wangwei xam ghe gwei ingwei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux nox me na tyoung gheyapu wei mindei takwei yo on tyek xam ghe bou naleimim ambei nya?
Laweeng mi wong mapieing wou moux alis vex. Xe neing se teyei bei devind xey. Qayeeng beimambei wei a neil wou xam eno inyon laweeng me xel on mapieing.
Ekom xam valu seng wongis.” En myaxeeng eno Yesu woulek e tiwei se wongis o me tyek na toung e na eivek xel ba memend o.
Moxo tetulexe me neil embei, “Inye vati wei a neil wou xam bei xelti se teyei bei nam wou ay, qe ka Mang bo nikanzek wou e le.”
Lek bouk tiyon eno e xe xel betiyeing ngenongakes pekwi me lox me la de xel se betiwou e no.
Yesu teling wou e xe xel betiyeing xoumeeng yuw on bei, “Xam is xam ambeing na veil ay?”
Simon Petele lewexe wou e, “Tambiy Ngandoung, tyek xa na wou eti? Wa xe qayeeng on mi wo mapieing luta luta.
Xa wongis me na woulek bei wang on Vambuing tiwei Anutu yo.”
Woyom Yesu neil elox bei, “A beyal xam xoumeeng yuw. Ekom xam on ti eno laweeng nol!”
Moxo neil inyon en Yudas wei Simon Iskariot neu moux o, inyon xel xoumeeng yuw eno ti, wei tyek na neil e teyei me na toung e na eivek xel ba memend o.
